title.narrative: Establishing the National Information Platform for Nutrition in Ethiopia (NIPN Ethiopia)

description.narrative: The National Information Platform for Nutrition aims at supporting countries to strengthen their capacity to analyse and value available information to better inform the strategic decisions they are faced with to prevent malnutrition and its consequences. In Ethiopia, the NIPN set-up and implementation will be ensured through two complementary actions whose activities are interwoven to achieve a functioning platform. The present action is led by the International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI) and is complementary to the one led by the Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI).
